devdoc.details: Graph Proxy contract used to delegate call implementation contracts and support upgrades. This contract should NOT define storage as it is managed by GraphProxyStorage. This contract implements a proxy that is upgradeable by an admin. https://docs.openzeppelin.com/upgrades-plugins/1.x/proxies#transparent-proxies-and-function-clashes

acceptUpgrade().details: Admin function for new implementation to accept its role as implementation.

acceptUpgradeAndCall(bytes).details: Admin function for new implementation to accept its role as implementation.

admin().details: Returns the current admin. NOTE: Only the admin and implementation can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103`

implementation().details: Returns the current implementation. NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc`

pendingImplementation().details: Returns the current pending implementation. NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0x9e5eddc59e0b171f57125ab86bee043d9128098c3a6b9adb4f2e86333c2f6f8c`

setAdmin(address).details: Changes the admin of the proxy. NOTE: Only the admin can call this function.

upgradeTo(address).details: Upgrades to a new implementation contract.

params._newImplementation: Address of implementation contract NOTE: Only the admin can call this function.
